QuestInfo.name: A Banquet for the Whalians
QuestInfo.1: I'm finally done cooking the special entree for the Whalians. I'd better take it to #bPorchay#k quick!
QuestInfo.2: I don't think the Whalians will have to worry about food for a while.

1.0: Oh you're back! I've been waiting for you!

yes.0: Wow! Kenta sure cooked up a feast! I can just imagine the Whalians smiling at the thought of eating this. Thank you so so much!

npc.0: Please take this feast and give it to Porchay. She seemed to need it right this minute, so please hurry your way back to her.

lost.0: What you lost it?? I have some spare, but please don't lose it again.

0.0: Here's the feast. Can you please take this and go deliver it to Porchay?

yes.0: Here it is! Give this to #bPorchay#k, and please let her know that if she ever runs out again, all she needs to do is let me know, and I'll make some for her.

no.0: I guess you don't need to go to Victoria Island yet. Yes, it is a long way from here.
